title: Текстовый файл
semantics: Текстовый файл Proposed extension, not installed: one delimited import appends same-schema files and preserves duplicates. Choose source_paths OR source_mask; legacy source_path remains single-file. Each concrete source needs its own issued receipt. Lists skip empty entries, retain nonempty order and require at least one file. Mask: * in the basename only, one assigned directory, no recursion; sources must cover the observed current matching set. Reexecute a saved mask against the current directory, never promise a frozen set or sorted order. Additional output FileName is string; FileTime is datetime when requested. Configure service columns separately from CSV columns. Heterogeneous schemas are outside initial acceptance; never silently merge by names or claim lossless positional import. Save separately.

preview_only.description: source.kind=storage; settings.source={source_path}; finish=close; inputs=mappings=read.ports=[]. Read encoding/format/columns and <=25 rendered rows; discard without Execute. server_profile: coverage=preview, no SHA/full N. Reuse node after download/profile/scan/sample.

source_switch.description: Only for an existing text or Excel import: after an exact full scan and package.save_checkpoint, switch settings.source.source_path (text) or excel.source_path and optional sheet_name (Excel) alone, preserve/reopen-check all columns and output mapping; text uses finish:done/read.ports:[], then dock_storage_source immediately before one terminal-node Execute with source identity/size/SHA rechecked; Excel uses Execute and verifies full output-0 row count. Only profile_id is supplied: backend binds an exact scan receipt to the delivered source digest. Missing receipt yields N not verified with a reason, never successful count verification. Never supply expected_records. No column, format or mapping changes allowed. Timeout: inspect the SAME operation, never execute again.

source.description: Required for new imports and configuration changes: kind:storage with server_source_ref from a native Files observation selects an existing server file WITHOUT upload; or kind:verified_delivery with artifact_id and upload_operation_id from completed verified delivery (legacy delivery IDs remain accepted). Optional bytes and sha256 must match that receipt. Omit source only to execute an unchanged existing Import: settings:{}, inputs:[], mappings:[], finish:execute and read.ports:[0]. This uses the saved native configuration without uploading again; an old upload ID is not a current receipt.

source_paths.description: Ordered absolute storage paths; empty entries are skipped. At least one nonempty item. Aggregate native source text <=2048 characters; join internally with U+FF5C.

source_mask.description: Absolute path in one assigned directory; only * in basename. No URL, recursion, directory wildcard, ? or mixed list/mask in the first increment. Refuse no matches.

parallel_processing.description: New multi-file default false; omission on an existing import preserves it.

max_threads.description: Native maximum; relevant only with parallel_processing=true. Preserve when omitted.

file_info.description: Initial acceptance: none/name. FileName and optional FileTime are generated service fields, not CSV input columns; path/time acceptance is proposed separately.

source_name.description: Observed source name or unique CSV header/label; never guess transliteration. name=result identifier, label=title.

settings.description: Optional settings.format.multiple_delimiters is boolean; date_format is an explicit dd/mm/yyyy, mm/dd/yyyy, yyyy/mm/dd, dd/mm/yy, mm/dd/yy or yy/mm/dd order and date_separator is ., /, backslash or -. Omission preserves native settings, including on partial existing-node patches; no automatic encoding or date substitution. For target.kind=new supply all three objects: source, format, columns. source requires source_path (the verified delivery destination), encoding, rows_to_skip, first_line_as_title. format requires delimiter, decimal_separator, null_marker, text_qualifier. columns must describe every CSV field with name, label, type, data_kind, used; source_name optionally identifies an original field when renaming. At least one field must be used. For target.kind=existing settings is a patch: omitted settings are preserved, and settings:{} reuses the saved configuration. A column patch identifies its field by source_name or name. Proposed multi-file branch uses sources instead of source. settings.source uses source_paths OR source_mask instead of source_path; encoding/header/format/CSV columns remain explicit. Existing omission preserves saved selection and processing options.

sources.description: Proposal: concrete issued source receipts, one per nonempty list entry or current mask match; exclusive with legacy source. Never use a single file receipt as authority for a directory mask.

parameter_schema.description: Proposal only. Existing delimited single-file contract is preserved. New multi-file requests use sources plus source_paths/source_mask. No new public tool, deadline or top-level mode. Runtime must check exclusive branches, all source identities and complete schema before mutation; these guards are not installed by this document.
